observation.command:
cd /workspace && grep -A4 'readiness_probe' process-compose.yaml | grep -E 'path' | sort -u | head; echo "=== probe backend health endpoints ==="
for port in 18000 18001 18002 18003 18005 18006 18007 18008 18009 18010 18011 18012 18013 18014 18015 18016; do
  code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -m 3 "http://localhost:$port/health" 2>/dev/null)
  code2=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -m 3 "http://localhost:$port/healthz" 2>/dev/null)
  echo "port $port: /health=$code /healthz=$code2"
done
